profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, trading under the ticker LUMN, with CIK 0000018926. On its own site it describes itself as providing secure networking, edge cloud and AI-ready infrastructure over a global fiber network, and calls itself the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy. It says its fiber footprint reaches across markets and is meant to reduce latency for real-time performance.

The site presents AI readiness mainly through customer examples rather than named products. It describes a private, low-latency network built for heavy AI workloads for Prometheus Hyperscale, which anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady. It also describes programmable, consumption-based networking for the New York Yankees with diverse 100G paths and automatic failover, built-in automation for Arctic Glacier, and an AI-era network for the urgent care provider American Family Care, which was scaling across 26 states. Retail is named as another area where the network is said to provide transaction security and DDoS protection.

The company's record shows no lawsuits and no tracked products or MCP servers. Louisiana is listed as a jurisdiction with a law exposure count of 57.
